build_model: build a LLaMA model with LoRA adapters for causal language modeling on a specific GPU device
train_llm: train a LLaMA model with LoRA fine-tuning on Alpaca-style instruction data using SPDL or PyTorch dataloaders
build_spdl_dataloader: build a high-performance SPDL data loading pipeline with concurrent tokenization and batch aggregation
build_pytorch_dataloader: build a standard PyTorch DataLoader for Alpaca-format JSONL data with distributed sampling and multiprocessing
main_cli: run the LLM fine-tuning CLI with torchrun for distributed training on multiple GPUs with configurable LoRA parameters
